description: Where an activity's answers are stored. One row states which CRM Task table field holds them, whose columns they are, and how a single row is addressed. Form layout is declared on the task type instead.

fields.label: Section Key
fields.description: The key a CRM Task Type Field names to say where its answer lands. Every field naming this section is routed by the row below.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: What these answers are called where no heading is present — a Smart View picker or a grid column. This names storage, not form layout.

fields.label: Display Order
fields.description: Ascending: the order sections are resolved in, and which one answers as the key-value default.

fields.label: Target DocType
fields.description: The doctype whose columns these fields are. Every field naming this section is resolved against it, so a field that is not one of its columns is refused.

fields.label: Child Table Field
fields.description: The Table field on CRM Task holding these rows, e.g. custom_engagement. Left blank the section IS the task row itself, and the target must then be CRM Task.

fields.label: Is Multi Row
fields.description: Not available to a task section and refused on save. An activity field is addressed by a column, never by a row key, so a question asked many times is declared in a key-value section instead.

fields.label: Row Key Field
fields.description: The column identifying one row. On a key-value section it carries the declared fieldname a row answers, and every consumer picks the latest row by it.

fields.label: Is Key Value
fields.description: One row per declared field, addressed by its fieldname rather than by a named column. A new activity field is then a declaration row and never a schema change. Exclusive with Multi Row.

fields.label: Value Field
fields.description: The column holding a key-value row's answer, e.g. value. Required when key-value; every consumer reads the answer through it.

fields.label: Label Field
fields.description: The column holding what a key-value row is called. An activity field already carries its label on the task type, so a task section leaves this blank rather than storing a second copy.

fields.label: Question Field
fields.description: The column holding the raw key a key-value row's identity was derived from, e.g. fieldname. Required when key-value: it is what a row says it was addressed by.

name: CRM Task Section
